name: Laguna Churup
why: The acclimatisation hike of Huaraz: a green lake under a glacier peak, with a short scramble on cables at the end.
book: Park ticket at the Pitec control. Taxi or colectivo from Huaraz (45 min).
dangers: The last 30 minutes are rock slabs with fixed cables: hands needed, slippery when wet.

points.name: Pitec
points.note: The ranger post at the road end, 3,850 m.

points.name: Churup rock slabs with fixed cables
points.note: The scramble beside the waterfall below the lake.
